question: Who is always dear to the Lord among yogis?
premises: The yogi is content and self-controlled.
The yogi offers mind and intellect to the Lord.
inference: The yogi who is content, self-controlled, firmly resolved, and offers mind and intellect to the Lord is dear to the Lord.
uncertainties: The fused compound gloss is an editorial paraphrase.
plain_english: The yogi who is always content, self-controlled, firmly resolved, and has offered mind and intellect to the Lord is dear to the Lord.
